objective_pt: Contar o que outra pessoa disse, pediu ou perguntou ("She told me...", "He asked if...") numa conversa natural.

teacher.goal_pt: Puxar fofocas leves e recados para ver como o aluno reporta falas.
prompts: What did your boss say in your last meeting?
Has anyone given you good news recently? What did they say?
watchFor: Dizer "she said me"; com pessoa é "she told me" ou "she said to me".
Manter o tempo verbal original sem necessidade quando o contexto já é passado (aceitável na fala, mas observar).

exercises.prompt: She told me she was leaving the company next month.
accepted: She told me she was leaving the company next month.
She told me that she was leaving the company next month.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa direto. Use "told me" ou "said to me".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was leaving the company next month.

options: He told me he was tired.
He said me he was tired.
He told that he was tired.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Tell" precisa da pessoa ("told me"). "Say" funciona sem a pessoa ("he said he was tired").

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ele me disse que estava ocupado."
accepted: He told me he was busy
He told me that he was busy
He said he was busy
He said that he was busy
He said to me that he was busy
He said to me he was busy

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não aceita a pessoa direto. Diga "He told me" ou "He said".
commonErrors.correction_en: He told me he was busy.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tell" precisa dizer para quem: "He told me that...". Sem a pessoa, use "said".
commonErrors.correction_en: He told me he was busy.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender verbos de relato além de "say" e "tell": mention, explain, ask, warn, admit, promise, suggest.
prompts: Did anyone warn you about something recently?
What did your friend suggest last time you asked for advice?
watchFor: Dizer "he suggested me to go"; o natural é "he suggested (that) I go" ou "he suggested going".

exercises.example_en: She mentioned that the office would be closed on Friday.
He warned me not to take the highway at rush hour.
She admitted that she had forgotten the meeting.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each verb to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Ela me lembrou de ligar para o cliente."
accepted: She reminded me to call the client
She reminded me to call the customer
She reminded me to phone the client
She reminded me that I had to call the client
She reminded me I needed to call the client
She reminded me to give the client a call

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Remember" é lembrar você mesmo. Para fazer outra pessoa lembrar, use "remind": "She reminded me to...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para uma tarefa, use "remind someone to do something": "reminded me to call".
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ligar para" alguém é "call someone", sem preposição.
commonErrors.correction_en: She reminded me to call the client.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a fala encadeada em "told me", "asked if" e "said that" (o "that" fraco).
prompts: Say "he asked if" quickly. Does it sound like one word?
How do you say "that" in "she said that"?
watchFor: Pronunciar o "that" de relato com força; ele fica fraco ("thət").

exercises.prompt: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.
accepted: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.
She asked whether I could stay a bit longer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em pergunta reportada não há inversão: "asked if I could".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked if I could stay a bit longer.

exercises.prompt: He said that the train had already left.
accepted: He said that the train had already left.
He said the train had already left.

exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de som sem vibração, como "k", o "-ed" soa "t": "askt".

teacher.goal_pt: Ouvir uma fala direta e repassá-la para outra pessoa com discurso indireto.
prompts: Your colleague left a message. What did she say?
What did the doctor ask you?
watchFor: Manter a ordem de pergunta no relato: "he asked where was the station".
Esquecer de trocar os pronomes ("I" vira "she").

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to Mark. Then choose the correct report.
exercises.listen: I'll send you the files tomorrow morning.
options: Mark said he would send me the files the next morning.
Mark said I will send you the files tomorrow.
Mark told he sends the files.
exercises.explanation_pt: No relato, "I'll" vira "he would", "you" vira "me", e "tomorrow morning" pode virar "the next morning".

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to your colleague. Then tell your boss what she said, starting with "She said...".
exercises.listen: I'm stuck in traffic, so I'll be about twenty minutes late.
accepted: She said she was stuck in traffic and she would be about twenty minutes late
She said she was stuck in traffic, so she'd be about twenty minutes late
She said she was stuck in traffic and would be twenty minutes late
She said she's stuck in traffic and she'll be about twenty minutes late
She said she's stuck in traffic, so she'll be twenty minutes late
She said she'd be about twenty minutes late because she was stuck in traffic
She said she would be twenty minutes late because of the traffic
She said she was stuck in traffic
She said she'd be about twenty minutes late
She said she'll be twenty minutes late

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ao relatar, troque o pronome: o "I" dela vira "she": "She said she was...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She said she was stuck in traffic and would be about twenty minutes late.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Say" não leva a pessoa direto. Use "She told me..." ou "She said...".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told me she was stuck in traffic.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "stuck in traffic", sem "the".
commonErrors.correction_en: She said she was stuck in traffic.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen to the question. Then report it, starting with "He asked me...".
exercises.listen: Where did you buy that jacket?
accepted: He asked me where I had bought that jacket
He asked me where I bought that jacket
He asked me where I'd bought that jacket
He asked me where I bought my jacket
He asked me where I had bought my jacket
He asked me where I got that jacket
He asked me where I'd got my jacket
He asked me where I bought the jacket

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta reportada não há inversão nem "did": "He asked me where I bought...".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me where I had bought that jacket.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ele perguntou sobre você, então "you" vira "I": "where I bought".
commonErrors.correction_en: He asked me where I bought that jacket.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma conversa que aconteceu (no trabalho, com um amigo, com o médico) usando vários verbos de relato.
prompts: Tell me about a conversation that surprised you.
What exactly did they say? And what did you answer?
watchFor: Dizer "he asked me if I can" quando o contexto pede "could" (aceitável na fala; comentar se repetir).

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ela me perguntou se eu queria ir à festa."
accepted: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party
She asked me whether I wanted to go to the party
She asked if I wanted to go to the party
She asked whether I wanted to go to the party
She asked me if I wanted to come to the party
She asked me if I'd like to go to the party
She asked me if I wanted to go to the party with her

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em pergunta reportada, a ordem é de afirmação e sem "did": "asked me if I wanted".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "asked" no passado, o verbo da pergunta normalmente também vai para o passado: "if I wanted".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ask for" é pedir algo. Para perguntar, é "asked me if".
commonErrors.correction_en: She asked me if I wanted to go to the party.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Meu chefe me pediu para terminar o relatório até sexta."
accepted: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday
My boss told me to finish the report by Friday
My boss asked me to get the report done by Friday
My boss asked me to have the report finished by Friday
My manager asked me to finish the report by Friday
My boss asked me to finish the report before Friday
My boss wants me to finish the report by Friday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Pedir para alguém fazer algo" é "ask someone to do something": "asked me to finish", sem "for".
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "asked me" use "to" + verbo: "asked me to finish".
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Até sexta" como prazo é "by Friday". "Until Friday" é algo que continua até sexta.
commonErrors.correction_en: My boss asked me to finish the report by Friday.

accepted: He asked me what time the meeting started

exercises.instruction_pt: Tell your friend about a conversation you had recently. Report what was said and asked.
exercises.prompt_en: You look surprised. What happened? What did they tell you?
guidelines_pt: Report statements: "She told me that...", "He said..."
Report a question: "Then she asked me if..." or "...asked me where..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar "say" e "tell", perguntas reportadas e "remind" e "remember".
prompts: What did you tell your family about this course?
What did your teacher ask you last time?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Ele prometeu que ia me ajudar."
accepted: He promised he would help me
He promised that he would help me
He promised he'd help me
He promised to help me
He promised me he would help me
He promised me that he'd help me
He promised he was going to help me

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Como "promised" está no passado, "will" vira "would": "He promised he would help me".
commonErrors.correction_en: He promised he would help me.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "promised to help" ou "promised he would help".
commonErrors.correction_en: He promised to help me.

exercises.sentence: She ___ us that the meeting was cancelled.
accepted: told

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com a pessoa logo depois ("us"), usamos "told": "She told us". Ou "She said that..." sem "us".
commonErrors.correction_en: She told us that the meeting was cancelled.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which report is correct for: "Are you hungry?"
options: She asked if I was hungry.
She asked was I hungry if.
exercises.explanation_pt: Perguntas de sim ou não são reportadas com "if" ou "whether" e ordem de afirmação: "if I was hungry".

exercises.prompt: Apparently, she said it was the best trip of her life.
accepted: Apparently, she said it was the best trip of her life.
